task_description: Create and deploy a Lambda + EventBridge + SNS architecture for persistent B300/H200 spot capacity polling. Every 3 minutes, Lambda probes spot capacity across multiple regions/AZs. When capacity is found, it launches the benchmark EC2 instance with full user-data, sends SNS notification, and disables further polling for that instance type. Instances are launched with SELF_TERMINATE=false so the user can SSH/SSM in for debugging.
